title: Add justfile with common development tasks
description:
Create a justfile (just command runner) at the workspace root with recipes: `just build` (cargo build --workspace), `just test` (cargo nextest run --workspace), `just lint` (fmt check + clippy), `just bench` (cargo bench --workspace), `just clean` (cargo clean), `just doc` (cargo doc --workspace --open), `just key` (generate a test operator key pair in /tmp/). Artifact: justfile.

Acceptance: all recipes work; `just --list` shows all recipes with descriptions; justfile is the recommended way to run common tasks (documented in CONTRIBUTING.md)
